about: A container (tank, jar, tube or battery) whose contents rise or drain to each level as it is said, with named marks up its side: how full, a reserve, a charge, a dose, a supply running low.

levels.about: levels it goes to in turn, from 0 to 1 (or percentages)

marks.about: names up the side from empty to full, split by |; name@0.4 puts one at a level

showPercent.about: 1 writes the level as a percentage under it

color.about: the contents' colour name, such as highlight or accent

when.about: moments it moves to each level; else one after another
